purpose: Dated navigational registry for source discovery. Listing a source does not mean all rules on that page have been verified or are applicable to every member, provider, county, service, or plan.

status_legend.official_page_reviewed: An official landing/index page has been opened and checked for the described purpose.
status_legend.document_review_required: The linked document or exact passage must be reviewed before a policy claim is encoded.
status_legend.historical_snapshot: The record describes a prior dated check and must be rechecked for current use.

sources.title: Behavioral HealthChoices
sources.scope_note: High-level program description and county-assigned BH-MCO context; not a complete rule or rate source.

sources.title: Behavioral HealthChoices: Information for Providers
sources.scope_note: Provider-facing overview; verify exact product, provider type, county, service, and current contract before applying a statement to a case.

sources.title: Behavioral HealthChoices: Managed Care Organizations
sources.scope_note: Use as a dated county-to-BH-MCO lookup. Dated snapshot of the full county mapping preserved at docs/source-snapshots/bhc-mcos-2026-10-10.md (verified 2026-10-10: covers PA's 67 counties exactly once). A county mapping alone does not establish provider credentialing, open network status, benefits, or reimbursement.

sources.title: Behavioral HealthChoices Publications
sources.scope_note: Index for PS&R, appendices, financial reporting requirements, ASAM rates and member handbook. Review the linked item and its effective date before encoding anything.

sources.title: Behavioral HealthChoices Systems Management
sources.issuer: Pennsylvania Department of Human Services / OMHSAS
sources.scope_note: Resource discovery for encounter systems and operational materials; not evidence that nonpublic data are available to this project.

sources.title: Physical HealthChoices Managed Care Organizations
sources.scope_note: Keep physical-health MCOs distinct from Behavioral HealthChoices BH-MCOs.

sources.title: CHIP Insurance Companies
sources.scope_note: Check current county availability and exact plan/product.

sources.title: ACA Health Rate Filings
sources.program: Individual and small-group commercial insurance markets
sources.scope_note: Market coverage area and premium filings do not prove a provider's network participation or behavioral-health reimbursement.

sources.title: Coverage Areas for 2026 Individual Market Plans
sources.scope_note: Historical plan-availability snapshot for 2026, not the current or future plan year and not a provider network directory.

sources.title: Pennie: Pennsylvania's Official Health Insurance Marketplace
sources.program: Individual and family health insurance marketplace
sources.scope_note: Use for current individual-plan shopping and availability; do not infer provider participation from marketplace availability.

sources.title: Medicaid Managed Care Rate Review and Rate Guides
sources.scope_note: Federal guidance; confirm which rating period and authority apply to the modeled analysis.

sources.title: Request Behavioral HealthChoices Program Services
sources.scope_note: Member-facing explanation of access routes, county mental-health offices, BH-MCOs, provider directories and help when access is difficult. Not a full benefit specification or provider contract.
